line: Crowley's Prince of Disks: Vau of the Name (pdf p139); the airy part of Earth and the span from Aries to Taurus (pdf p169).

sections.title: The court and its element
sections.line: Crowley on the Princes (pdf p139) and on the Prince of Disks (pdf p169).

quotes.quote: The Princes represent the Forces of the letter Vau in the Name.
The Prince of Disks represents the airy part of Earth, indicating the florescence and fructification of that element.

sections.title: Its span in the Zodiac
sections.line: Crowley on the span from the 21st degree of Aries to the 20th degree of Taurus (pdf p169); on the decans and the elemental attribution (pdf p139).

quotes.quote: He rules from the 21st degree of Aries to the 20th degree of Taurus.
instead of assigning the three decans of each sign to one card, the influence begins with the last decan of one Sign and continues to the second decan of the next.
It might well be expected that the elemental attribution would harmonize with the Zodiacal attribution; but it is not so.

sections.title: Character
sections.line: Crowley on the character of the Prince of Disks (pdf p169).

quotes.quote: The character denoted by this card is that of great energy brought to bear upon the most solid of practical matters.
